rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday Cantonese noun for the infection caused by HIV.

example.english: My friend was diagnosed with HIV before and is receiving treatment now.
example.traditional: 我朋友之前驗到有愛滋病，而家接受緊治療。
example.jyutping: ngo5 pang4 jau5 zi1 cin4 jim6 dou2 jau5 oi3 zi1 beng6 ji4 gaa1 zip3 sau6 gan2 zi6 liu4
